mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the civilian unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and expanding equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
